title: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.33005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. translated_title: Leto：以效用为中心的智能体记忆
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖外部记忆来在多次交互之间保留和复用信息。现有的记忆系统将记忆视为对过去的记录，并根据其与对话的保真度来评估。然而，记忆的价值在于它能否改善智能体的响应。记忆系统需要在该响应产生之前就决定记忆什么以及提供什么，而保真度检验并未将这两个决策与响应挂钩。因此，忠实于对话的记忆可能无法改善响应。我们转而将记忆视为一个预测问题，并提出了Leto，一个面向LLM智能体的记忆系统，它关注记忆对未来请求的效用，而非其对应于过去的保真度。由于未来的请求是未知的，Leto通过记忆索引保留对对话细节的访问，使信息能够通过其来源持续可用。当请求到达时，记忆回放利用该索引来预判性地重建（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Leto，一个以效用为中心的LLM智能体记忆系统，通过记忆索引与记忆回放机制，关注记忆对未来响应的效用而非对过去对话的保真度。
en_tdlr: Leto is a utility-centric memory system for LLM agents that, through memory indexing and replay, prioritizes the utility of memory for future responses over its fidelity to past conversations.
